title: From Pre-Genesis to MSS-N
description:
This preprint organizes admission and observation questions into typed preservation and repair contracts. It develops report sufficiency on the actual report image, demand accounting, old-image recovery, and homological limits on preservation under chain retractions. Exact finite examples connect graph components, integral triangle repair, free-word normal forms, and rational Bell mixtures. Standalone Lean constructions and executable Python and Rust companions expose the assumptions and replay scope. The WDP reading route identifies additional data required for conditional finite-QM constructions; it does not derive physics from syntax.

Version 1.0.0 is an author review draft. Local verification does not imply a public deposit or publication approval. Manuscript and documentation licensing is distinguished from code licensing below.
